_about: Public-domain William Edwin Orchard (1877-1955), minister of the King's Weigh House, London, who was received into the Catholic Church in 1932, for the Word Hoard: his books printed before 1930: The Finality of Christ, Modern Theories of Sin, Sermons on God, Christ and Man, The Temple (a book of prayers), The Real War, The Necessity of Christ, The Outlook for Religion, The True Patriotism, The Order of Divine Service, Oracles of God, No More War, Foundations of Faith, Christianity and World-Problems, and The Present Crisis in Religion. He lived past 1930, so only books printed before 1930 are taken. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 117 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

orchard-finality: The finality of Christ and other sermons (London : George Allen and Unwin, Ltd, 19--)
orchard-theories-sin: Modern theories of sin. Thesis approved for the degree of Doctor of Divinity in the University of London (London, J. Clarke, 1909)
orchard-sermons: Sermons on God, Christ, and man (London : James Clarke, 1913)
orchard-temple: The temple; a book of prayers (New York, E.P. Dutton & Co., London, J.M. Dent & Sons, ltd., 1914)
orchard-real-war: The real war (London ; Toronto : H. Milford, Oxford University Press, 1914)
orchard-outlook: The outlook for religion (New York And London, Funk & Wagnalls Co., 1917)
orchard-patriotism: The true patriotism and other sermons (London : G. Allen & Unwin, 1918)
orchard-divine-service: The Order of Divine Service for public worship, the administration of the Sacraments and other rites and ceremonies, and a selection from the daily offices, compiled from ancient and modern devotions, together with an abridged and revised Psalter and Canticles pointed for chanting (London, Milford, 1921)
orchard-oracles: Oracles of God : studies in the Minor Prophets (London : Clarke, 1922)
orchard-no-more-war: No more war, and other sermons (London, G. Allen & Unwin, 1922)
orchard-foundations-1: Foundations of faith (New York, George H. Doran Co, 1924)
orchard-foundations-2: Foundations of Faith, II, Christological, vol. 1 (George H. Doran Company, 1926)
orchard-foundations-4: Foundations of Faith Volume 4: Eschatological (Routledge, Chapman & Hall, Incorporated, 1927)
orchard-present-crisis: The present crisis in religion (New York, London, Harper & Brothers, 1929)
